brief: Enter at (29.64994, -89.96224) for Priority 1, closest to 9 isolated buildings [F3]. Enter at (29.64878, -89.96243) for Priority 2, closest to 1 isolated building [F4]. 56 road pieces were checked: 38 judged flooded, 5 uncertain, the rest judged dry [F1]. There are 10 buildings isolated cut off from every exit road, 4 uncertain, 0 still reachable, and 1 with no mapped road nearby [F2]. Testing on 20 SpaceNet 8 tiles marked 1 of 666 truly cut-off buildings reachable, with 'isolated' right roughly 4 to 5 in 10 where most buildings could still get out and 98 in 100 where nearly all were cut off; treat 'isolated' as a reason to check, not a confirmed cut-off [F5]. Flood judgements are from a vision model reading satellite photos, not field-verified, so uncertain roads need a drone or ground check [F6].
